# TabPlayer patch to usvg 0.45.1

Upstream: https://github.com/linebender/resvg/tree/1b6c2fddbcbeffa8135df4323b02aaae84890907/crates/usvg

The exact crates.io source archive has SHA-256 `80be9b06fbae3b8b303400ab20778c80bbaf338f563afe567cf3c9eea17b47ef`, matching TabPlayer's pre-patch Cargo.lock. `UPSTREAM-SOURCE.json` records every original packaged file's byte length and SHA-256. All 39 packaged files are retained byte-for-byte except `src/text/layout.rs`; the original Cargo.lock is upstream source, not a newly generated lockfile. Registry `.cargo-ok` is excluded. Apache-2.0 and MIT license texts are unchanged.

Only executable change: fallback shaping merges complete source clusters instead of equating glyph-array indices and counts. Clusters are contiguous glyph groups sharing an original UTF-8 source start. A group's source end is the maximum start plus cluster byte length, including zero-length members. A missing primary group is replaced only by a fully resolved fallback group covering the exact same nonempty source interval. Complete primary groups retain their original font, glyph IDs, metrics and ligatures. Primary visual order is retained, including right-to-left runs. Incompatible or partial groups remain unresolved for strict PDF rejection. The existing attempted-font list remains in effect even when no cluster can be replaced. The old all-matched shortcut is removed because it replaced already-resolved primary glyphs.

Seven focused synthetic unit tests cover ligature count differences, equal counts with incompatible byte ranges, multi-glyph/zero-length members, partially missing groups, incompatible/partial replacements, sequential fallback fonts, and visual RTL order. TabPlayer's native PDF tests cover the exact mixed Unicode title, multiple real fallback fonts around real Latin ligatures, nonzero glyph IDs and vector outlines, retained unsupported-character rejection, font embedding, dimensions and denied external resources.

No feature/shaping disable flags, font substitutions, SVG rewriting, system font loading, or permissive missing-glyph behavior were added. Remove this patch once an upstream version demonstrates equivalent source-cluster fallback behavior with these regressions passing; keep the same strict export checks during that migration.

To run only the dependency tests using the application's already-pinned dependency versions and target directory, temporarily copy `src-tauri/Cargo.lock` over this crate's upstream Cargo.lock, set CARGO_TARGET_DIR to the application's existing target directory, run `cargo +1.90.0 test --manifest-path vendor/usvg/Cargo.toml --offline fallback_tests --lib`, then restore the original upstream Cargo.lock. The implementation's final source inventory verification confirms it was restored. This avoids changing application dependencies or resolving the upstream crate's older standalone lockfile.
